summary: Documentation-only phase freezing the canonical contract governing the first Repository Intelligence read-only prototype. Defines docs/PHASE_120_REPOSITORY_INTELLIGENCE_PROTOTYPE_CONTRACT_FREEZE.md, the normative specification binding all later Track 120 implementation work (120D-120F). Restricts the first prototype to generating only Repository Knowledge Snapshot artifacts. Freezes the conceptual input model (allowed: repository working tree, repository metadata, tracked documentation and artifacts, governed lifecycle metadata, verified 119 schemas; excluded: external services, AI inference, network sources, runtime state mutation, execution outputs) and output model (one schema-conformant, deterministic, read-only, fully attributable snapshot per run). Freezes a determinism contract, ten read-only guarantees, a source attribution contract, the Evidence boundary, an uncertainty contract, a limitation contract, the ten conceptual prototype stages carried forward from 120A, a persistence contract deferring the final output location to 120D among 120A's three candidates, a verification contract with no validators implemented, a fail-closed failure contract, and a governance contract. Documents relationship to 120C-120F and carries forward the same three known inherited, non-blocking tooling/reporting issues from 119AC/120A without repairing them. No schema, source, or test file was changed; no generator, validator, CLI, or automated test suite was implemented.
tests_added_or_updated: None. 120B was a documentation-only contract-freeze phase and did not add automated tests.
contract_scope: Governs exactly one prototype: the first Repository Intelligence read-only prototype, whose sole implementation target is the Repository Knowledge Snapshot artifact family. Binding on 120D, 120E, and 120F.
relationship_to_119: Does not alter, extend, or reinterpret the 119 schema line; freezes the rules under which a future prototype may produce artifacts conforming to schemas/repository_intelligence/artifacts/repository_knowledge_snapshot.schema.json.
relationship_to_120a: Freezes the 120A architecture into binding, normative rules. Where 120A described an option range (e.g. three candidate persistence locations), this contract either freezes a rule or explicitly defers the choice to a later phase.
first_prototype_target: Repository Knowledge Snapshot only (schemas/repository_intelligence/artifacts/repository_knowledge_snapshot.schema.json). No other artifact family is included in the first implementation.
input_model_summary: Allowed: repository working tree, repository metadata, tracked documentation, tracked repository artifacts, governed lifecycle metadata, previously verified 119 schemas. Excluded: external services, AI inference, network sources, runtime state mutation, execution outputs.
output_model_summary: Exactly one Repository Knowledge Snapshot artifact per generation run: schema-conformant, deterministic, read-only, fully attributable, bounded by explicit limitations.
determinism_contract_summary: Identical repository inputs must produce identical snapshot structure, excluding approved metadata fields (e.g. timestamps) that do not affect substantive content. No probabilistic reasoning, sampling, or AI inference permitted.
read_only_guarantees_summary: The prototype shall never modify repository files, modify runtime state, execute repository code, execute shell commands, invoke AI providers, invoke external APIs, mutate Repository State, mutate Evidence, mutate Advisory, or replace Decision Evaluation.
source_attribution_contract_summary: Every extracted fact must identify its source via a deterministic Source Attribution Record; missing attribution is contract failure.
evidence_boundary_summary: Repository Intelligence is not Evidence and must never replace it; may later support Evidence via Evidence Link Records only.
uncertainty_contract_summary: Unknown, incomplete, conflicting, and unverifiable information must be represented explicitly using the frozen 119 uncertainty vocabulary, never inferred or collapsed.
limitation_contract_summary: Generated artifacts must be accompanied by limitation records, disclaimer records, boundary disclosures, and uncertainty records when appropriate.
persistence_contract_summary: Conceptual only; no storage implementation specified. Final output location decision deferred to 120D among 120A's three candidates (.pcae/repository-intelligence/, artifacts/repository-intelligence/, reports/repository-intelligence/); persistence must occur only through the existing PCAE governed lifecycle.
verification_contract_summary: Conceptual verification expectations (schema parse, schema conformance once a validator exists, source attribution completeness, unknown/limitation presence, boundary/disclaimer presence, determinism) without implementing validators.
failure_contract_summary: Fail-closed: the prototype must refuse to produce non-conformant artifacts on missing required sources, attribution failures, schema mismatch, unknown mandatory fields, or boundary violations.
governance_contract_summary: Future prototype phases must preserve the observe-only boundary, governed lifecycle compliance, repository cleanliness, deterministic operation, auditability, and reproducibility.
